items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Shields, and -- [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, all that stuff, that you would find -- would find in Africa, and skins, and stuff, you know. Statues.

ctx.x: Now they had 12 or 13 piece band down onstage who played for the acts, chorus girls acts, or whatever they were, you know, when we came in, and you look up where it would be the spotlight up there, that's where the Safari Room could sit there and look down on the people, and it was a beautiful room with all kind of African gadgets, and things, and hanging all on the wall, you know, this stuff.
Yeah, all that stuff, that you would find -- would find in Africa, and skins, and stuff, you know. Statues.
